departments.title: Our Departments
departments.subtitle: Comprehensive modern academic curricula combining religious and secular learning

play_to_five.title: Play - Class 5
play_to_five.desc: Child-centric kindergarten education providing standard secular schooling alongside pure Quran recitation, Tajweed, Duas, and Islamic etiquette.

hifzul_quran.title: Hifzul Quran
hifzul_quran.desc: Under the close mentorship of seasoned Huffaz, children memorize the Holy Quran with authentic international vocal intonations.

kitab.title: Kitab Division
kitab.desc: Standard academic coursework in Quranic exegesis, Hadith sciences, Arabic syntax, and Islamic jurisprudence.

after_school_maktab.title: After-School Maktab
after_school_maktab.desc: 5 flexible daily shifts tailored for school-going students to master Quranic recitation, daily Sunnah supplications, and core Islamic beliefs.

after_school_hifz.title: After-School Hifz
after_school_hifz.desc: A specialized modern program allowing school students to systematically memorize the Holy Quran alongside regular academics.

alem_alema.title: Alem & Alema Course
alem_alema.desc: In-depth Shariah and theology degree programs conducted across dedicated separate campuses for male and female students.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Why Markazul Iman Dhaka is unique and exceptional

safe_environment.title: Safe, Clean & Child-Friendly Environment
safe_environment.desc: Highest security measures, hygienic campus sanitation, and a nurturing atmosphere prioritizing child well-being.

integrated_syllabus.title: Integrated Religious & Secular Syllabus
integrated_syllabus.desc: A harmonious blend of Islamic values with contemporary modern school curricula.

character_building.title: Akhlaq, Etiquette & Humanitarian Values
character_building.desc: Focused emphasis on Sunnah-based moral character, filial piety, and humanitarian virtues.

joyful_learning.title: No Severity—Education through Love & Care
joyful_learning.desc: Affectionate, joyful, and supportive pedagogical methods nurturing children's emotional and intellectual growth.

dual_education.title: Dual Instruction: Islamic & General Education
dual_education.desc: Fluency in Bengali, English, Mathematics, Science, and Computing alongside foundational Islamic disciplines.

spoken_language.title: Mandatory Spoken Arabic & English
spoken_language.desc: Compulsory active practice in Arabic and English conversation to prepare students for global excellence.

handwriting_class.title: Specialized Handwriting Classes in 3 Languages
handwriting_class.desc: Expert-led dedicated calligraphy classes for mastering handwriting in Bengali, English, and Arabic.

goals.title: Our Vision for Your Child
goals.subtitle: A concrete blueprint for a Quran-centric prosperous future

quran_in_childhood.title: Inscribing the Holy Quran in Their Hearts During Childhood
quran_in_childhood.desc: Instilling the authentic words of Allah with pristine pronunciation during formative childhood years.

khatam_by_grade_two.title: Complete Quran Recitation Completion by Grade 2
khatam_by_grade_two.desc: Achieving full Nazira recitation of the Holy Quran with correct Tajweed rules by second grade.

hafez_by_grade_five.title: Aiming to Complete Quran Memorization by Grade 5
hafez_by_grade_five.desc: A structured pathway enabling students to graduate as Hafez-e-Quran before completing primary schooling (Insha'Allah).

quran_centric_life.title: Cultivating a Quran-Centric Lifestyle
quran_centric_life.desc: Inspiring students to embody Quranic values and the Prophetic Sunnah in their academic, professional, and personal lives.

batches.title: After-School Maktab Batches & Schedule
batches.subtitle: 5 flexible daily shifts (1 hour daily) designed for school-going students

batch_1.title: 1st Batch (Morning)
batch_1.desc: Fresh early-morning session before school starts, focusing on Noorani Quran with Tajweed and daily supplications.

batch_2.title: 2nd Batch (Morning)
batch_2.desc: Morning shift providing an engaging, joyful learning experience for young primary students.

batch_3.title: 3rd Batch (Afternoon)
batch_3.desc: Afternoon shift right after regular school dismissal, dedicated to Quranic recitation and Sunnah ethics.

batch_4.title: 4th Batch (Evening)
batch_4.desc: Convenient pre-Maghrib session covering Nazira reading, Masnoon prayers, and fundamental rulings.

batch_5.title: 5th Batch (Night)
batch_5.desc: Evening session designed for senior school students balancing busy daytime school schedules.

reviews.title: Guardian & Community Testimonials
reviews.subtitle: Valued feedback regarding the academic standards and moral environment at Markazul Iman Dhaka
reviews.guardian_1: The care and dedication of the teachers at Markazul Iman Dhaka enabled my child to make unprecedented progress in Quran recitation in a short period.
reviews.guardian_2: The balanced combination of Islamic sciences with modern English and Mathematics impressed me deeply. The campus hygiene is exemplary.
reviews.guardian_3: The After-School Maktab is an absolute blessing for our family. Our children learn authentic Deen without disturbing their regular schooling.

profile.title: Institute Profile
profile.intro: Markazul Iman Dhaka is a multipurpose Islamic education center established as an integrated Kindergarten and Hifz Madrasah.
profile.history: Situated in historic West Nakhalpara, Tejgaon, Dhaka, the institution nurtures young boys and girls in separate campuses into morally grounded, intellectually capable citizens.
profile.mission_text: To develop an exemplary, competent, and God-fearing generation through the harmonious integration of Islamic values, Quran memorization, and modern schooling.
profile.vision_text: To serve as an international benchmark institution where children joyful memorize the Holy Quran and excel in contemporary academic disciplines.

founder.title: Founder's Profile
founder.name: Respected Founder & Principal
founder.message: Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem. Dear parents and community members, cultivating our children with Quranic wisdom and modern excellence is our highest duty. At Markazul Iman Dhaka, your child's education will be safe, fulfilling, and blessed, Insha'Allah.
founder.bio: Guided by prominent scholars and seasoned educators, Markazul Iman Dhaka has established itself as an exemplar of balanced education.

vision.title: Vision & Mission
vision.v1: Adherence to the Quran and Sunnah

committee.title: Managing Committee
committee.desc: Under the advisory guidance of eminent Islamic scholars and educationists, the administration of Markazul Iman Dhaka operates with transparency and excellence.

roadmap.desc: The multidimensional journey and progressive vision of Markazul Iman Dhaka
roadmap.p1_desc: Training and grooming students for international Quran recitation and memorization competitions.
roadmap.p2_desc: Establishing a rich Islamic library and modern science lab to foster intellectual and scientific curiosity.
roadmap.p3_desc: Building infrastructure for comparative research between classical Islamic sciences and contemporary knowledge.

policies.title: Institutional Policies
policies.desc: Rules and guidelines designed to maintain a disciplined, clean, and organized academic environment for all students and guardians.
policies.discipline_text: Punctual attendance and full adherence to institutional codes of conduct are mandatory for every student.
policies.dress_code_text: Sunnah attire and Islamic caps for boys; modest, Shariah-compliant hijab for girls.
policies.attendance_text: Absences without prior written approval are not permitted, except in cases of documented emergencies.

faculty.desc: Under the constant guidance of competent, compassionate, and dedicated male and female teachers.

staff.title: Officials & Support Staff

academics.subtitle: The integrated modern and religious curriculum of Markazul Iman Dhaka
academics.levels_desc: Well-structured curricula spanning Play to Class 5, Hifzul Quran, and Kitab Division.
academics.routine_desc: Timely schedules and academic calendars updated regularly for every class.
academics.syllabus_desc: Balanced co-curricular activities supporting physical fitness, mental sharpness, and spiritual growth.
academics.teachers_list_desc: Information and direct communication channels for assigned class teachers.

hostel.title: Hostel & Residential Facilities
hostel.subtitle: A safe, clean, and well-governed residential campus
hostel.about_desc: For students coming from afar, we offer spacious and well-equipped boarding facilities. Featuring 24-hour backup electricity, filtered drinking water, nutritious meals, and round-the-clock security surveillance.
hostel.directors_desc: Experienced hostel superintendents and wardens providing paternal guidance and constant student supervision.
hostel.rules_desc: Mandatory adherence to institutional residential bylaws for peace, hygiene, and mutual respect.
hostel.routine_desc: A disciplined lifestyle schedule starting from Tahajjud and Fajr through study sessions and nightly rest.
hostel.chart_desc: Organized and separate residential seat distributions for boys and girls campuses.

admission.title: Admission Guidelines & Information
admission.subtitle: Guidelines and information for enrollment in the 2026-2027 academic session at Markazul Iman Dhaka
admission.timeline_desc: Admission forms must be collected and submitted within the announced intake schedules.
admission.test_desc: Age-appropriate academic assessments and welcoming interviews with guardians.
admission.process_desc: Complete the form online or in person, submit required documents, and finalize enrollment by paying the admission fee.
admission.fees_desc: Affordable fee structures tailored to provide premium-quality education without compromise.
admission.terms_desc: Birth registration certificate, passport photos, and previous school transfer records are required.
